# K-Logistikus opens Bicol hub to speed up regional deliveries

 Chie Manalo August 15, 2026 August 15, 2026 0 4 mins 

K-Logistikus Philippines is expanding deeper into the regions as it strengthens its nationwide logistics network with the opening of a new cross-dock hub in Tabaco City, Albay.

The 1,500-square-meter Bicol Crossdock Hub is designed to help businesses move goods faster across the region, shorten delivery lead times, and respond more efficiently to shifting consumer demand.

Strategically located along the Tabaco-Ligao Road, the facility will serve as a key distribution gateway to Camarines Sur, Sorsogon, Catanduanes, and Masbate, improving connectivity between mainland Bicol and nearby island provinces.

For K-Logistikus, the expansion reflects growing demand for faster, more flexible logistics solutions as companies seek to build more efficient and resilient supply chains.

July 23, 2026

- The new hub will enhance operational efficiency, support the company’s Authorised Service Partner network, and improve access to cross-border shipping services.
- The expansion forms part of Garudavega’s nationwide growth strategy to meet rising demand for international logistics and e-commerce solutions.

# K-Logistikus Opens Bicol Crossdock Hub to Boost Regional Distribution

 By: Bob Reyes 

 On: August 14, 2026 

K-Logistikus Philippines has expanded its nationwide logistics network with the opening of a new Bicol Crossdock Hub in Tabaco City, Albay, strengthening the movement of goods across the Bicol Region.

The 1,500-square-meter facility, strategically located along the Tabaco-Ligao Road, serves as a distribution gateway for Camarines Sur, Sorsogon, Catanduanes and Masbate. It can handle up to 20 outbound trucks daily and is positioned near major retail centers and transport routes to support faster distribution of fast-moving consumer goods and improve access to nearby island provinces.

“Bicol is an important growth corridor, and strengthening our presence in the region allows us to better support the evolving needs of businesses and the communities they serve,” said Sulficio O. Tagud Jr., president and CEO of K-Logistikus Philippines.
